process_documentation: Fetched the official BKG VG250 boundary-line layer in EPSG:25832 through WFS 2.0, selected federal-state boundaries with AGZ=2 and land boundaries with GMK=0, projected them into the same 1536×1536 north-up view box as the country outline, simplified them deterministically by 0.55 px, and emitted a transparent SVG overlay without labels or invented borders.
notes: Visual inspection confirms the internal boundaries align with the Germany outline and remain readable at the 1024 px proof size.
The gold line treatment is distinguishable from water by both hue and line structure and is intended as an overlay, not a standalone map.
No labels, disputed claims, invented borders, external resources, scripts, or raster data are embedded.
